mapper.select: SELECT s.scenario_id, s.scenario_title, s.description, s.estimated_minutes, s.is_active, s.category_id, c.category_name FROM scenario s LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY s.scenario_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE scenario SET scenario_title = #{scenarioTitle}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalStarts, SUM(CASE WHEN progress_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalCompleted FROM simulation_progress WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId}

SELECT ss.step_id AS stepId, ss.step_order AS stepOrder, CONCAT(ss.step_order, '. ', ss.step_title) AS stepTitle, COUNT(sp.progress_id) AS saveCount FROM scenario_step ss LEFT JOIN simulation_progress sp ON ss.step_id = sp.step_id AND sp.scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND sp.progress_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'ABANDONED') WHERE ss.scenario_id = #{scenarioId} GROUP BY ss.step_id, ss.step_order, ss.step_title ORDER BY ss.step_order ASC
